children: RNS Number : 9034T  Phoenix Spree Deutschland Limited  08 September 2026
New directorship notification under Listing Rule 6.4.9 (2)

PSD hereby gives notification, pursuant to Listing Rule 6.4.9 (2), that Antonia Burgess, Non-Executive Director of the Board of the Company, has been appointed, with effect from 8 September 2026, as a Non-Executive Director of Foresight Solar Fund Limited, a company listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange.
